name: Puerto Vallarta
tagline: Pacific beach town of cobbled streets and jungle mountains
summary: Puerto Vallarta is a Pacific resort with real-town charm: cobblestone streets, a seafront Malecón of sculptures, the crown-topped Our Lady of Guadalupe church and jungle-covered mountains falling into Banderas Bay. Whales visit in winter.
seasonNote: November to April is dry; humpback whales from December to March. Summer is hot, humid and rainy.
arrival: Puerto Vallarta Airport is 20 minutes from downtown.
gettingAround: Buses and taxis; water taxis to southern beaches.
cashTip: Carry pesos for taxis, tacos and markets; cards work in hotels and bigger restaurants. Pay in pesos, not dollars, for a better rate.
foodTip: Pescado zarandeado, shrimp tacos and raicilla.
